title: FY27 AIWW Shoreline Protection
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SAD > US ARMY ENGINEER DISTRICT CHARLESTO
description: DESCRIPTION OF WORK: FY27 AIWW Shoreline Protection - The work consists of furnishing all plant, equipment, labor, transportation, fuel, lubricant, supplies and materials; and performing all operations in connection with installation of shoreline protection and dike realignment in AIWW Placement area 1110S W-C, including clearing and appurtenant items. The work is located in Charleston County, South Carolina. Magnitude of Work is Estimated Between: $1,000,000 TO $5,000,000.  North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 237990 Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with a SBA Small Business Size of $45,000,000. This solicitation is hereby posted as of 16 November 2026.
